prompts.exactText: Create the DAY-SIGNATURE candidate scene for Milford Sound / Piopiotahi, New Zealand. Landscape 4:3. View from a quiet natural foreshore across calm fiord water toward Mitre Peak. Geography must be immediately recognizable: Mitre Peak is a very steep, asymmetrical pyramidal mountain rising directly from the water, with a narrow clear summit and descending jagged shoulder; dark near-sheer rock faces and forested lower slopes; massive U-shaped glacial fiord walls recede on both sides; restrained native beech shoreline and pale blue-gray reflections. Keep the summit silhouette crisp against a spacious pale daylight sky; do not turn it into a generic snowy cone. At bottom-center, intentionally compose a broad, quiet, pale natural rock shelf/shore patch that is grounded, low-detail, low-contrast, and completely unmarked for a future seated/gazing Portrait; keep recognition features above it and keep edges, plants, reflections, and objects out of this quiet patch. STYLE ONLY from the three attached references: preserve only locked intensity-B watercolor language—thin warm gray-brown pencil/ink linework, translucent low-saturation sage and blue-gray washes, restrained ochre, subtle warm-white paper grain, gentle controlled watercolor bleed, airy negative space, quiet nostalgia. Use the center B panel only from the triptych. Do not copy or include any reference subject, cat, bird, torii, room, furniture, object, icon, postcard frame, layout, writing, stamp, or decoration. This scene contains NO ANIMALS at all, including no distant birds or silhouettes.
